'''Vanløse IF''' is a Danish professional [[association football|football]] club based in the [[Vanløse]] area of [[Copenhagen]], that competes in the [[Danish 3rd Division]]. The club has a rich history with former players like [[Preben Elkjær]] and [[Michael Laudrup]] and have won the [[Danish Cup]] in [[1973–74 Danish Cup|1974]]. It currently has about 1000 members.<ref>{{in lang|da}} Referat fra General Forsamling 2013, 20 February 2013: http://vanloeseif.dk/data/1588/filedb/30794.pdf</ref>"}}
